invariants.name: Axiomatic minimality
invariants.rule: axiom CHU : Type only — no inhabitant, no equation, no structure added
invariants.forbids: axiom chu_inhabited : Inhabited CHU; axiom CHU_eq : CHU = ...; etc.
invariants.rationale: Model-independence — any proof transfers to any concrete CHU model

invariants.name: Predicate-as-piece
invariants.forbids: def CHUPiece : Set CHU := ...; def CHUPiece := { x : CHU // p x }
invariants.rationale: Avoid Mathlib + set-theory commitment; preserve Yoneda perspective

invariants.name: Self-similar coverage
invariants.rule: JaebaeMan inductive has exactly two constructors: atomic / governs
invariants.forbids: Adding a third constructor (e.g. concat, weighted, etc.)
invariants.rationale: Keep the inductive minimal — extensions live in separate types (e.g. AirplaneMan_Gap5_Cost.lean adds cost as a wrapper, not a third constructor)

invariants.name: OR-union coverage
invariants.rule: JaebaeMan.covers uses ∨ in governs case (open-cover semantics)
invariants.rationale: User canon allows overlapping resonance (공명), not strict partition; open-cover is the unique structure-free interpretation

invariants.name: Russell avoidance
invariants.rule: No CHU : CHU → Prop or similar Russell-style self-reference
invariants.rationale: Girard's paradox triggers regardless of universe level (both Type 0 and Type u). See NATURE_RUSSELL_AVOIDANCE.md.
